mentions.name: NameTheory
mentions.description: A domain search app for iOS that uses Apple Intelligence to help brainstorm domain name ideas. Built as the author's first iOS app, it doubles as an experiment with what small local models can do as they catch up to larger ones, and was started as something simple that scratches the author's own itch.
